# MediaManager

> **File:** `services/system/MediaManager.qml` · **Docs:** see [docs/dev](../../README.md)

The active MPRIS player (Spotify first, else one playing, else one that can play; or the one picked with selectPlayer) for the media widgets, the lockscreen and the media keys: its track, position and controls, and its album art downloaded to a local file.

### Properties

- `activePlayer` (var)
- `hasActivePlayer` (readonly bool): --- Properties we can pass through ---
- `isPlaying` (readonly bool)
- `playbackState` (readonly int)
- `position` (real): --- Properties we fully control to be explicit, partially due to a bug with YT Music ---
- `length` (real)
- `progress` (readonly real)
- `identity` (readonly string): --- Everything else ---
- `trackTitle` (readonly string)
- `trackArtist` (readonly string)
- `artUrl` (readonly string)

- `artVersion` (int): Bumped when new art lands, so images reload the same path
- `canTogglePlaying` (readonly bool)
- `canGoNext` (readonly bool)
- `canGoPrevious` (readonly bool)
- `canSeek` (readonly bool)
- `players` (readonly var): Every player, for player switchers
